system.description:
The 1975 rules give the spear 1d6 and the pike 1d6+1 (Strength over 80); 1d6 is set here. Raise it for a pike. 1975 rules values applied by weapon kind (Sec. 721): most weapons 1d6; daggers and light missiles 1d4; mace, flail, morning star, battleaxe, halberd, poleaxe and pike 1d6+1 with Strength over 80.

Swords & Glory price range in Káitars; the referee rolls (usually 1d10) for quality and the real price. The encumbrance cost uses the S&G scale (in hand or worn / hung or packed), not 1975 Káitar weights.
